name: io.github.KI-Klub-Werder-e-V/konmari
title: KonMari-Kit (MarieKondoForAgents)
description: Read-only access to organisational data products that are deduplicated, owned and PII-masked

packageArguments.name: --charter
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the pilot's charter.yaml

packageArguments.name: --config
packageArguments.description: Optional: absolute path to the pilot's connect.yaml (defaults apply if absent)

environmentVariables.name: KONMARI_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Agent identity registered with 'konmari govern agent'

environmentVariables.name: KONMARI_CATALOG
environmentVariables.description: Catalog URL of the pilot, e.g. duckdb:///path/to/.konmari/catalog.duckdb or postgresql://...

environmentVariables.name: KONMARI_ON_BEHALF_OF
environmentVariables.description: Optional: user the agent acts for (permissions are intersected)

environmentVariables.name: KONMARI_GROUPS
environmentVariables.description: Optional: comma-separated groups of that user

environmentVariables.name: KONMARI_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Optional: comma-separated read scopes granted to the agent
